name: Skeletal Cleric
sup: The Cleric deals no damage, so Meat Shield's damage penalty costs nothing — and it takes much less damage: 1.67× survival. Meat Shield II: 40% less damage taken. Gem tier 3: cut it from an Uncut Support Gem of level 3+. Until then: Meat Shield I.

The Cleric casts Heal and Resurrect 11% more often (1.79 → 1.99 casts/s). Rapid Casting III does nothing here — it counts your recent spells, not the Cleric's. Int. Rapid Casting II: 20% faster casting. Gem tier 4: cut it from an Uncut Support Gem of level 4+. Until then: Rapid Casting I.
More elemental resistance for the Cleric: 1.36× survival. Int. Gem tier 1: cut it from an Uncut Support Gem of level 1+.
More Life and size; doesn't raise the Cleric's Spirit cost: 1.19× survival. Int. Gem tier 4: cut it from an Uncut Support Gem of level 4+.
+1 level for the Cleric: 1.09× survival. Int. Gem tier 5: cut it from an Uncut Support Gem of level 5+.
note: Meat Shield is right here: it cuts the Cleric's damage (which it doesn't need) and the damage it takes. Infernal Legion is out — it sets the Cleric itself on fire. All five supports verified to fit its socket.
